internal_collaboration.campus_name: Screen Salon at the Salini Resort
internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: In 2002, Antoine and Louise opened their first hairdressing salon together in Bugibba, bringing their experience and passion for the craft into the business. Louise, a graduate of The School of Hairdressing in Malta, had already gained two years of industry experience before opening the salon. In 2018, the pair expanded further by opening a new Screen Salon at the Salini Resort.
